contract: a hall you buy a ticket in: a counter you can see over, a chest of tickets at every hatch, and the price in grass on the board
unverified: NOTHING HERE CARRIES A SIGNAL, so there is nothing to verify - which is the decision. Watching the chest itself cannot work: a comparator reads floor(1 + 14 * fullness) and a 27-slot chest moves 1/(64*27) per stackable item against the 1/14 needed, so the signal never changes. A 5-slot hopper of non-stackable tickets does step (~3 a ticket) and a delayed-copy detector for one is buildable - a comparator chain carries an analog level exactly and adds two ticks a stage, both measured here - but it was not built and asserted end to end, so it does not ship.
